# Group Ticket Information | Pittsburgh Steelers - Steelers.com  
Contact Us  
REQUEST MORE INFORMATION  
####  
ART ROONEY AVENUE TAILGATE  
A premium tailgate experience includes 20 game tickets and all-inclusive food and beverages. Enjoy a private pregame tailgate in the heart of pregame festivities, with food and drink and an appearance from a former Pittsburgh Steeler!  
REQUEST MORE INFORMATION  PREVIEW PACKAGE HERE  
####  
PNC CHAMPIONS CLUB EXECUTIVE PACKAGE  
The all-inclusive Club seat package for 10 includes premium seating in Field Club 1, a private pregame buffet, and access to the PNC Champions Club with exclusive amenities throughout the game.  
REQUEST MORE INFORMATION  PREVIEW PACKAGE HERE  
####  
TERRACE TAILGATE  
The ultimate Pittsburgh Steelers experience that includes 16 UPMC Sideline Club tickets, a private pregame meal in a space dedicated to your group, and pre-game warm-ups on the field for 4 guests!  
REQUEST MORE INFORMATION  PREVIEW PACKAGE HERE  
####
